_comment: Benign commit history seeded into the config repo so it looks lived-in. Edits are listed in the order they were made; the template holds the final (baseline) state, so init applies them in reverse to build the initial commit, then replays them forward.

initial.message:
Initial import of activation platform manifests

Migrated from the legacy Helm chart. Kustomize base plus a prod overlay.
initial.author: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@example.com>

edits.message:
gateway: raise upstream timeout to 2s

Activation latency review showed p99 orders calls at 1.4s during the Tuesday number-port batch; 1.5s left no headroom.
edits.author: Marcus Oyelaran <marcus.oyelaran@example.com>

edits.message:
inventory: run two replicas

Single replica meant every rollout was a brief outage for the plan catalogue and SIM lookups.
edits.author: Dana Whitfield <dana.whitfield@example.com>

edits.message:
orders: raise db pool to 10 per DBA sizing

Pool of 5 saturated during the device launch weekend. DBA confirmed 10 per pod fits the connection budget.
edits.author: Tomasz Weber <tomasz.weber@example.com>
